response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack development skills and leadership in open-source projects, but his experience lacks depth in C++ and large-scale cloud compute infrastructure, which are critical for this role. His background in technical mentorship and cross-functional collaboration is a positive signal, but the mismatch in core technical qualifications warrants a cautious recommendation.
strengths: Proven technical leadership and mentorship through workshops, talks, and open-source contributions (e.g., GISCollective, Fluent-Asserts).
Diverse experience across web, mobile, desktop, and embedded systems, with a focus on testable, scalable architectures.
Strong collaboration and knowledge-sharing ethos, evidenced by community engagement and dev-ops practices (CI/CD, GitLab, Docker).
concerns: Limited recent experience with C++ (only 1 year at National Instruments, 9+ years ago), falling short of the 8-year requirement.
Primary expertise in TypeScript/Node.js and distributed systems lacks alignment with cloud compute infrastructure (e.g., no explicit production cloud architecture experience).
Technical leadership roles are mostly informal (e.g., workshops, open-source) rather than formal team leadership in cloud/DevOps contexts.
